visualCharacteristics.purpose: row of key figures, each a bold value over a short label
visualCharacteristics.layout: borderless 4-up row on desktop, wraps on smaller screens; left-aligned text-only items

contentPattern.structure: one text cell: bold value paragraph (<strong>) followed by a label paragraph

reuseGuidance: Use for text-only statistics or key figures. Put it in a colored section (Style: blue) for white-on-blue. For image or icon cards use cards-grid.
